entities.name: Yasemin Güveli
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Yasemin Güveli is a Turkish professional volleyball player. She is 1.88 m tall at 70 kg (150 lb), and plays in the Middle Blocker position. She plays for Galatasaray in Istanbul, and is a member of the Turkey women's national volleyball team.
